nom: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Cream

avis.texte: I really like how this moisturizing cream feels good on my face. It leaves me looking very shiny and I love it!

So I really like this moisturizer, it feels very lightweight on the skin, not greasy or sticky. However I am currently on benzoyl peroxide and adapelene gel for acne maintenance. And using this over my gel moisturizer just doesn't hydrate enough for me. I have to use an additional noght cream on top. However in the morning's (when I don't use my adapelene gel) its perfect to layer under my sun screen, it doesn't pill off or anything. So in conclusion, solid moisturizer, doesn't pill, doesn't irritate, and my skin didn't react. But if your using acne medications, and you have a good moisturizer, I would stick with what you got.
It's light, it hydrates me very well, I like it because it doesn't leave my skin greasy
ive re bought this mostrurizer 7 plus times, literally best thing to ever exsist. keeps skin glowing ALL DAY.
I've only been using this a couple weeks but so far I like it. A good summer moisturizer. Haven't seen any sin improvements but it does moisturize very well for as light as it is.
This moisturizer is lightweight yet moisturizing and gentle on the skin.

This is a very good simple moisturizer for sensitive, not too dry skin. I have normal to dry skin & it doesnt work too good at hydrating my drier spots - i have to go in with a double layer or aquaphor. Didn't cause breakouts & has cooling gel/cream texture. Also, a lot of beneficial ingredients.

avis.titre: It's like a little pond is giving me forehead kisses
avis.texte: I really like this product, it's light but very moisturizing. I've been ordering online for a while now and they always deliver quickly. 5 stars! No notes!
Love this moisturizer. I find that I need way less than I think I need. As another reviewer mentioned, it can feel a bit sticky at first, but that goes away leaving soft, moisturized skin.

I bought this after many days of checking reviews for negative feedback. It's been 2 months and I have the worst, most painful acne I've ever had in my entire life. It get worse every week. My cheeks and jaw bone are covered in large, red, iritated pimples (some in clusters), and scars from the previous weeks. I stopped every other product in my skincare routine to try to narrow down what was causing this reaction. I'n now only using this and a sensitive bar soap to cleanse, so it has to be this product. I found other people on reddit who have had similar reactions to this brand's birch juice line. So if you have seasonal allergies or are allergic to any tree species, do not buy any of the birch products!

I tried this moisturizer to use during the spring and summer seasons in Central Texas, when it gets hot and humid. Having dry skin, I was afraid that this product wouldn't be enough, but I was wrong. This is exactly what I needed once it started to get more humid outside. Makes my skin soft all day with absolutely no greasiness. It tends to feel sticky upon first application, but the stickiness fades away after about an hour. Perfect moisturizer for those days, even if your skin leans on the drier side.
My skin is combination, oily in the T zone a d dry everywhere else.... Lightweight! Glides on my skin and leaves it feeling plump! For the price it's a great quantity too! Will repurchase

avis.titre: So dewy and light on my s
avis.texte: So dewy and light on my skin, love how it glossy my skin looks

I love the moisturizer, i have dry acne prone skin. I use this a base/ barrier moisturizer then will layer a heavy moisturizer or spf on top. Zero burring or irritation or acne. On my third jar, i use it morning and nignt

Bought this because it has such good ratings and I was on the hunt for a moisturizer that didnt compromise hydration for clogged pores. It does just that: zero breakouts or blackheads with insane, lightweight moisture. Pairs with any serum, making it the only moisturizer youll honestly ever need. 100/10

I have super sensitive skin, my friend brought me the moisturizer for my birthday, it is amazing, it does not irritate my face, I recently purchased it again. The1025 Dokdo Cleanser is also great, it makes a very nice lather, and does not irritate my skin, I would highly recommend this company!

avis.titre: So far my skin is in agre

This will be my fourth time repurchasing this moisturizer and I love! The lightweight feel pairs great with my combo/oily skin, but still leaves my skin feeling properly hydrated. Looks great under makeup too!

It does not leave your face sticky. I feel pretty after I put it on. I love it. If I am having acne, I will use it as my final step cream to not overload my face and let my skin breathe a bit. I bought some for my boyfriend.
I waited so long to purchase this, and the hype is real! I love this moisturizer! Lightweight gel that is super hydrating. Love it and will be purchasing again!
Love finally having a same-brand moisturizer to go with the sunscreen.

I genuinely enjoy this cream so far. I have acne prone skin that is oily and sensitive, but this cream has been working for my skin. It's a light moisturizer, so I don't feel it interfering and creating more oil on my face, which I love!

I decided to try something new, and found this in store. I absolutely love this product. Its super cooling when first applied, and although it feels tacky at first, when it dries you can't feel the product at all on your skin!
Excellent cream! Gel like but extremely moisturizing, doesn't clog pores. Cools and smooths skin. I love this moisturizer! Love all the Round Lab products in my skincare routine.

Extremely light weight and feels clean! I enjoy how gentle it is, and how it doesn't leave my face feeling like i have caked on makeup

The Round Lab Birch Juice Moisturizing Cream has a refreshing, lightweight texture that provides lasting hydration. It absorbs beautifully into the skin, leaving it soft, smooth, and naturally radiant. A perfect everyday moisturizer for healthy, glowing skin.

avis.titre: Nice- but don't like the texture
avis.texte: Not sure if I got a defective product? the description says nothing about the small balls of something within the cream. I've had skincare with bursting capsules before, but the ones in the birch cream take a lot of force to smooth out- more force than I like to use on my skin. I even rub the cream with my hands together to try and smooth it out before I put it on my face- to no avail. The cream itself is nice, but I hate how many of these balls are leftover unabsorbed on my face/hands. If they changed the texture I would give it 5 stars!

It goes on so smoothly and light but covers a great area with a small volume. My skin feels so properly hydrated when I wake up in the morning when I used to wake up with cracked dry and sad skin (high mountainous desert is rough on skin). 100% recommend, worth every cent
Totally in love with this moisturizer and the entire Birch line. Can't be without them

Overall this was one of the nicest creams I've ever tried, and I love how it sits on my skin and under my makeup but ... I really wish it didn't have those little beads in it because they're pretty tough to blend into the skin. Even if I rub the product between my hands before applying it, I still can't manage to pop them all, which leads to them ... sitting on my face, and me having to brush them off. If this cream didn't have those little beads it'd absolutely be my holy grail daytime moisturizer -- I'll finish the tub I have, but I don't know if I'll repurchase. I'd recommend it if you don't mind those un-popable beads!
